# VoidAI

## Docs

- [Create Speech](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/audio/speech.md): Convert text to speech audio
- [Create Transcription](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/audio/transcriptions.md): Transcribe audio into text
- [Create Translation](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/audio/translations.md): Translate audio into English text
- [Create Chat Completion](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/chat/completions.md): Generate text completions using chat models
- [Get Eligible Models](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/discounts/eligible-models.md): Get models eligible for discounts
- [Get My Discounts](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/discounts/my-discounts.md): Get your active discounts and time remaining
- [Create Embeddings](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/embeddings/create.md): Create vector embeddings from text
- [Edit Image](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/images/edits.md): Edit or extend images based on a prompt
- [Create Image](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/images/generations.md): Generate images from text prompts
- [Get Model](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/models/get.md): Get details about a specific model
- [List Models](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/models/list.md): List all available models
- [Create Moderation](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/moderations/create.md): Check text for potentially harmful content
- [Create Video](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/video/create.md): Generate videos from text prompts
- [Delete Video](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/video/delete.md): Delete a video and its associated assets
- [Download Video](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/video/download.md): Download a completed video or its assets
- [Get Video](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/video/get.md): Get the status and details of a video generation task
- [List Videos](https://docs.voidai.app/api-reference/video/list.md): List all videos for the authenticated user
- [Authentication](https://docs.voidai.app/authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate your API requests
- [Credits & Pricing](https://docs.voidai.app/guides/credits.md): Understanding how VoidAI credits work
- [Error Handling](https://docs.voidai.app/guides/errors.md): Understanding and handling VoidAI API errors
- [Using OpenAI SDK](https://docs.voidai.app/guides/openai-sdk.md): How to use VoidAI with the official OpenAI SDKs
- [Welcome to VoidAI](https://docs.voidai.app/index.md): Unified API gateway for AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, and more
- [Quickstart](https://docs.voidai.app/quickstart.md): Get started with VoidAI in under 5 minutes

## OpenAPI Specs
